name: China National Uranium Co., Ltd.
summary: China National Uranium Co., Ltd. engages in the mining, smelting, sale, and trading of natural uranium resources in China and internationally. It provides monazite, uranium-molybdenum, and tantalum-niobium products; and natural uranium, rare earth chloride, ammonium tetramolybdate, tantalum pentoxide, niobium pentoxide, and other related products. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Beijing, China. China National Uranium Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Nuclear Uranium Co., Ltd.
